java.say: The stock is private. Only FoodStore's own methods can change it.
Other code adds food through add().
add() checks the amount first. Zero or a negative amount is refused.
take() checks too: you cannot take more than there is. So the stock can never go below zero.
Other code may read the stock, but there is no setter. Every change goes through a method that checks it.
